title: Final Energy Expression
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct expression for the energy change, including terms for M_J, omega_l, and the summation over M_L.

title: Correct Hamiltonian
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly identify the Hamiltonian before and after the introduction of the magnetic field.

title: Use of Quantum Numbers
description: Important Criteria: The response must appropriately incorporate the quantum numbers J, L, S, and J_z in the calculations.

title: Energy Change Components
description: Important Criteria: The student should clearly separate the contributions to the energy change from both the J_z and S_z terms.

title: Summation Over M_L
description: Optional Criteria: The student may include a detailed explanation of the summation over M_L and its significance in the energy change.

title: Sign Mistakes
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid sign errors in the expression for the energy change, particularly in the terms involving M_J and M_L.

title: Units Consistency
description: Pitfall Criteria: The response must maintain consistent units throughout the derivation and final expression.
